messages:
laura: Heads-up: PR #812 updates the SDK migration guide and replaces several JS snippets with the new v2 param names. I'm planning to merge into staging tomorrow 10:00 PT, but the runtime 'v2-params' feature flag isn't flipped until release at 12:00 PT. Will the docs preview show the new snippets or the old ones if the flag is off? Want to avoid customers seeing mismatched examples. @ryan @priya

ryan: Good call asking. Preview snapshots build from staging artifacts but the snippet rendering uses the runtime that matches the flag state we pass to the preview job. By default previews pass flags=false. You can request a canary preview that sets flags=true.

priya: CI just failed snippet lint for that PR earlier. Error shows language fence mismatch and an output check failed. Pasting minimal log: `snippet-lint: FAIL docs/sdk/migrate.md line 88 expected: js found: js+comment`

laura: Ugh. I'll revert the code-fence change in the PR unless someone recommends another fix. We also need to add frontmatter so the page doesn't show on /docs/latest until the flag flips. Something like `hidden: true` and `feature_flag: v2-params`.

oliver: Instead of hiding, consider adding `release_tag: upcoming-v2` and a redirect rule `/docs/sdk/migrate -> /docs/sdk/migrate/v2/` so old bookmarks land on a stable route. Hiding pages makes search/indexing funky.

laura: Good point. I'll add the `release_tag` and a redirect note in the PR body. Also will keep the PR gated with `feature_flag` frontmatter.

ci-bot: Preview failed for PR #812: https://ci.example.com/builds/5890
[ERROR] snippet-lint: code-fence mismatch docs/sdk/migrate.md:88 expected fence: js found fence: js+comment

priya: The snippet-check script tolerates a `// expected` comment only if the fence is `js` exactly. Easiest fix: put the expectation in a separate fenced block labeled `output`. Example:
````
```js
const x = await client.foo();
````
```output
{ id: 123 }
````
````
That will satisfy the linter and keeps the snippet deterministic across flag states.

laura: Perfect. I'll patch the PR with that pattern. Timeline proposal: 09:00 PT 10:00 PT  11:00 PT - (09:00) land snippet-fix PR, (10:00) merge staging docs PR to create canary, (11:00) QA verifies canary with `?canary=true`, (12:00) flip v2-params flag at release cutoff. Can we lock merges during 11:45-12:30 local release window?

ryan: I can approve the snippet-fix at 08:30 PT. Priya, can you run `./bin/snippet-check --path docs/sdk --sha $PR_SHA` once laura pushes the patch?

priya: Yes. Also reminder: docs-preview links expire in 6 hours unless you add `?live=true`. docs-bot, can you post the canary checklist?

docs-bot: Canary checklist: 1) preview url posted, 2) run `snippets smoke` tests, 3) confirm redirects present, 4) search index rebuild queued. Use `?canary=true&live=true` for persistent review snapshots.

laura: Added redirect note and `release_tag: upcoming-v2` frontmatter. Pushed snippet-fix branch now. Tagging reviewers: @ryan @oliver.

ci-bot: Re-run preview for #812: https://ci.example.com/builds/5891 (running). Will post status here when finished.

oliver: If QA needs to test runtime examples before flipping the flag, run the preview with `env.FEATURE_V2_PARAMS=true` in the build job. That avoids touching prod flags.

laura: Thanks all  I'll wait for CI green and a QA ack before merging to main/staging. Please reply if you see any blockers. :thumbsup:
